question: How many accounts are there, including deleted ones?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts

question: How many accounts does each region have? Show the region name.
gold_sql: SELECT r.name, COUNT(*) FROM accounts a JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = a.region_id GROUP BY r.name
alt_gold_sql: SELECT r.name, COUNT(*) FROM accounts a JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = a.region_id WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY r.name

question: How many sales reps are on each team?
gold_sql: SELECT team, COUNT(*) FROM sales_reps GROUP BY team

question: List all plans with their per-seat price, cheapest first.
gold_sql: SELECT plan_name, list_price FROM plans ORDER BY list_price ASC

question: How many invoices are there for each status?
gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM invoices GROUP BY status

question: How many support tickets have not been closed yet?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tickets WHERE closed_at IS NULL

question: What is the average CSAT score across tickets that have a score?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(csat_score) FROM tickets

question: How many accounts are billed in each currency?
gold_sql: SELECT billing_currency, COUNT(*) FROM accounts GROUP BY billing_currency

question: How many subscriptions have been cancelled?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'cancelled'

question: What are the distinct ticket priorities?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT priority FROM tickets

question: What was the revenue in USD for each region in 2025? Revenue is the subtotal (before tax) of paid invoices; convert with the exchange rates. Show the region name.
gold_sql: SELECT r.name, SUM(i.subtotal * f.rate_to_usd) FROM invoices i JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = i.currency JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = i.account_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = a.region_id WHERE i.status = 'paid' AND i.issue_date >= '2025-01-01' AND i.issue_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY r.name

question: How many accounts churned in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts WHERE status = 'churned' AND churned_at >= '2025-01-01' AND churned_at < '2026-01-01'

question: What is the average number of seats per active subscription for each plan? Show the plan name.
gold_sql: SELECT p.plan_name, AVG(s.seats) FROM subscriptions s JOIN plans p ON p.plan_id = s.plan_id WHERE s.status = 'active' GROUP BY p.plan_name

question: Who are the top 5 sales reps by the number of active accounts they own? Return the rep name and the count, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT rp.full_name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM accounts a JOIN sales_reps rp ON rp.rep_id = a.sales_rep_id WHERE a.status = 'active' GROUP BY rp.rep_id, rp.full_name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5
alt_gold_sql: SELECT rp.full_name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM accounts a JOIN sales_reps rp ON rp.rep_id = a.sales_rep_id WHERE a.status = 'active' AND a.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY rp.rep_id, rp.full_name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many tickets were opened in each month of 2025? Show the month as YYYY-MM in chronological order.
gold_sql: SELECT substr(opened_at, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) FROM tickets WHERE opened_at >= '2025-01-01' AND opened_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: What is the average resolution time in hours for closed tickets, by priority?
gold_sql: SELECT priority, AVG((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24) FROM tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY priority

question: How many accounts have more than one contact?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT account_id FROM contacts GROUP BY account_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

question: Which accounts have had at least one failed payment? Return the company name.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.company_name FROM payments p JOIN invoices i ON i.invoice_id = p.invoice_id JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = i.account_id WHERE p.status = 'failed'

question: Which plan has the most active subscriptions? Return only the plan name.
gold_sql: SELECT p.plan_name FROM subscriptions s JOIN plans p ON p.plan_id = s.plan_id WHERE s.status = 'active' GROUP BY p.plan_id, p.plan_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many invoices were issued in each quarter of 2025? Label the quarters 2025-Q1 to 2025-Q4.
gold_sql: SELECT '2025-Q' || ((CAST(substr(issue_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3) AS q, COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE issue_date >= '2025-01-01' AND issue_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY q

question: What percentage of invoices are void?
gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'void' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM invoices

question: How many Enterprise-segment accounts are there in each region? Show the region name.
gold_sql: SELECT r.name, COUNT(*) FROM accounts a JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = a.region_id WHERE a.segment = 'Enterprise' GROUP BY r.name

question: How many usage events were recorded for each feature in December 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT feature, COUNT(*) FROM usage_events WHERE event_date >= '2025-12-01' AND event_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY feature

question: Which clients have never opened a support ticket? Return the company name.
gold_sql: SELECT a.company_name FROM accounts a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tickets t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id)

question: What is the total number of seats on active subscriptions for each account segment?
gold_sql: SELECT a.segment, SUM(s.seats) FROM subscriptions s JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = s.account_id WHERE s.status = 'active' GROUP BY a.segment

question: How many tickets are there per category? Treat different capitalizations of the same category as one.
gold_sql: SELECT LOWER(category), COUNT(*) FROM tickets GROUP BY LOWER(category)

question: How many accounts signed up in each quarter of 2024? Label the quarters 2024-Q1 to 2024-Q4.
gold_sql: SELECT '2024-Q' || ((CAST(substr(signup_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3) AS q, COUNT(*) FROM accounts WHERE signup_date >= '2024-01-01' AND signup_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY q

question: Which payment method has the most successful payments? Return only the method.
gold_sql: SELECT method FROM payments WHERE status = 'succeeded' GROUP BY method ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which email addresses are used by contacts at more than one account? Return the email and the number of accounts.
gold_sql: SELECT email, COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) FROM contacts GROUP BY email HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) > 1

question: Which company names are shared by more than one account?
gold_sql: SELECT company_name FROM accounts GROUP BY company_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

question: What is the monthly recurring revenue (MRR) in USD as of 2025-12-31? For each active subscription take seats times the plan's per-seat price after the subscription's discount percentage, and divide annual plans by 12.
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(s.seats * p.list_price * (1 - s.discount_pct / 100.0) / CASE WHEN p.billing_period = 'annual' THEN 12.0 ELSE 1.0 END) FROM subscriptions s JOIN plans p ON p.plan_id = s.plan_id WHERE s.status = 'active'

question: Show monthly revenue in USD for 2025 (paid invoices, subtotal before tax, converted with the exchange rates) together with the percentage growth over the previous month. Return the month as YYYY-MM, the revenue and the growth percentage in chronological order; the first month has no growth.
gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT substr(i.issue_date, 1, 7) AS month, SUM(i.subtotal * f.rate_to_usd) AS rev FROM invoices i JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = i.currency WHERE i.status = 'paid' AND i.issue_date >= '2025-01-01' AND i.issue_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY month) SELECT month, rev, 100.0 * (rev - LAG(rev) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / LAG(rev) OVER (ORDER BY month) FROM m ORDER BY month

question: Which 10 accounts generated the most revenue in USD in 2025 (paid invoices, subtotal before tax)? Return the company name and the revenue, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT a.company_name, SUM(i.subtotal * f.rate_to_usd) AS rev FROM invoices i JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = i.currency JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = i.account_id WHERE i.status = 'paid' AND i.issue_date >= '2025-01-01' AND i.issue_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.company_name ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 10

question: What was the churn rate in 2025, in percent? Divide the number of accounts that signed up before 2025-01-01 and churned during 2025 by the number of accounts that signed up before 2025-01-01 and had not churned before 2025-01-01.
gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts WHERE signup_date < '2025-01-01' AND churned_at >= '2025-01-01' AND churned_at < '2026-01-01') / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts WHERE signup_date < '2025-01-01' AND (churned_at IS NULL OR churned_at >= '2025-01-01'))

question: For each region, which sales rep owns the most accounts? Return the region name, the rep name and the number of accounts.
gold_sql: SELECT name, full_name, n FROM (SELECT r.name, rp.full_name, COUNT(*) AS n, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, rp.rep_id) AS rn FROM accounts a JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = a.region_id JOIN sales_reps rp ON rp.rep_id = a.sales_rep_id GROUP BY r.region_id, r.name, rp.rep_id, rp.full_name) WHERE rn = 1

question: What is the average number of days between the invoice issue date and the successful payment date, for each billing currency of the invoice? Use payments with status succeeded.
gold_sql: SELECT i.currency, AVG(julianday(p.paid_at) - julianday(i.issue_date)) FROM payments p JOIN invoices i ON i.invoice_id = p.invoice_id WHERE p.status = 'succeeded' GROUP BY i.currency

question: What is the total refunded amount in USD for each refund reason, highest first? Convert each refund using the currency of the invoice that was refunded.
gold_sql: SELECT rf.reason, SUM(rf.amount * f.rate_to_usd) AS usd FROM refunds rf JOIN payments p ON p.payment_id = rf.payment_id JOIN invoices i ON i.invoice_id = p.invoice_id JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = i.currency GROUP BY rf.reason ORDER BY usd DESC

question: What is the net revenue in USD for 2025? Take the total (including tax) of paid invoices issued in 2025, convert it to USD, and subtract the refunds made in 2025, converted with the currency of the refunded invoice.
gold_sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(i.total * f.rate_to_usd) FROM invoices i JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = i.currency WHERE i.status = 'paid' AND i.issue_date >= '2025-01-01' AND i.issue_date < '2026-01-01') - (SELECT SUM(rf.amount * f.rate_to_usd) FROM refunds rf JOIN payments p ON p.payment_id = rf.payment_id JOIN invoices i ON i.invoice_id = p.invoice_id JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = i.currency WHERE rf.refunded_at >= '2025-01-01' AND rf.refunded_at < '2026-01-01')

question: Show the running total of revenue in USD (paid invoices, subtotal before tax) by month for 2025. Return the month as YYYY-MM and the running total in chronological order.
gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT substr(i.issue_date, 1, 7) AS month, SUM(i.subtotal * f.rate_to_usd) AS rev FROM invoices i JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = i.currency WHERE i.status = 'paid' AND i.issue_date >= '2025-01-01' AND i.issue_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY month) SELECT month, SUM(rev) OVER (ORDER BY month) FROM m ORDER BY month

question: For each region, which account has the most support tickets? Return the region name, the company name and the ticket count.
gold_sql: SELECT name, company_name, n FROM (SELECT r.name, a.company_name, COUNT(*) AS n, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, a.account_id) AS rn FROM tickets t JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = a.region_id GROUP BY r.region_id, r.name, a.account_id, a.company_name) WHERE rn = 1
alt_gold_sql: SELECT name, company_name, n FROM (SELECT r.name, a.company_name, COUNT(*) AS n, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, a.account_id DESC) AS rn FROM tickets t JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = a.region_id GROUP BY r.region_id, r.name, a.account_id, a.company_name) WHERE rn = 1

question: How many accounts used more units in December 2025 than the average December 2025 usage per account, counting only accounts that had usage that month?
gold_sql: WITH u AS (SELECT account_id, SUM(units) AS t FROM usage_events WHERE event_date >= '2025-12-01' AND event_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY account_id) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM u WHERE t > (SELECT AVG(t) FROM u)

question: Which accounts have overdue open invoices as of 2025-12-31 (status open and due date before 2025-12-31)? Return the company name and the overdue total in USD (invoice total converted with the exchange rates), largest first.
gold_sql: SELECT a.company_name, SUM(i.total * f.rate_to_usd) AS od FROM invoices i JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = i.currency JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = i.account_id WHERE i.status = 'open' AND i.due_date < '2025-12-31' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.company_name ORDER BY od DESC

question: What share of 2025 revenue in USD (paid invoices, subtotal before tax) comes from each account segment? Return the segment and the percentage.
gold_sql: WITH s AS (SELECT a.segment, SUM(i.subtotal * f.rate_to_usd) AS rev FROM invoices i JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = i.currency JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = i.account_id WHERE i.status = 'paid' AND i.issue_date >= '2025-01-01' AND i.issue_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY a.segment) SELECT segment, 100.0 * rev / (SELECT SUM(rev) FROM s) FROM s

question: What is the average CSAT score for each sales team? Use the team of the sales rep who owns the ticket's account.
gold_sql: SELECT rp.team, AVG(t.csat_score) FROM tickets t JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN sales_reps rp ON rp.rep_id = a.sales_rep_id GROUP BY rp.team

question: How many invoices were paid only after a failed payment attempt, meaning the invoice has at least one failed payment and one succeeded payment?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices i WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments p WHERE p.invoice_id = i.invoice_id AND p.status = 'failed') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments p WHERE p.invoice_id = i.invoice_id AND p.status = 'succeeded')

question: Of the accounts that signed up in the first quarter of 2024, how many are still active at the end of 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts WHERE signup_date >= '2024-01-01' AND signup_date < '2024-04-01' AND status = 'active'

question: For each month-end of 2025, how many tickets were still open, meaning opened on or before that month-end and not closed by then? Return the month as YYYY-MM and the count in chronological order.
What is the seat-weighted average discount percentage across active subscriptions?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(seats * discount_pct) * 1.0 / SUM(seats) FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'active'

question: How many accounts have invoices but have never had a paid invoice?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT account_id FROM invoices GROUP BY account_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0)

question: Who are the top 5 sales reps by 2025 revenue in USD (paid invoices, subtotal before tax) from the accounts they own? Return the rep name and the revenue, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT rp.full_name, SUM(i.subtotal * f.rate_to_usd) AS rev FROM invoices i JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = i.currency JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = i.account_id JOIN sales_reps rp ON rp.rep_id = a.sales_rep_id WHERE i.status = 'paid' AND i.issue_date >= '2025-01-01' AND i.issue_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY rp.rep_id, rp.full_name ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is our customer acquisition cost (CAC) by region?
Show the Net Promoter Score by region.
How many employees does each client company have?
Remove all void invoices.
Mark every open invoice as paid.
List the accounts in the Antarctica region.
gold_sql: SELECT a.company_name FROM accounts a JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = a.region_id WHERE r.name = 'Antarctica'

question: How many enterprise accounts are in europe?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts a JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = a.region_id WHERE a.segment = 'Enterprise' AND r.name = 'Europe'

question: How many active accounts are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts WHERE status = 'active' AND deleted_at IS NULL
alt_gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts WHERE status = 'active'

question: What was our total revenue in USD in 2025? Return a single number.
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(i.subtotal * f.rate_to_usd) FROM invoices i JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = i.currency WHERE i.status = 'paid' AND i.issue_date >= '2025-01-01' AND i.issue_date < '2026-01-01'
alt_gold_sql: SELECT SUM(i.total * f.rate_to_usd) FROM invoices i JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = i.currency WHERE i.status = 'paid' AND i.issue_date >= '2025-01-01' AND i.issue_date < '2026-01-01'

SELECT SUM(p.amount * f.rate_to_usd) FROM payments p JOIN invoices i ON i.invoice_id = p.invoice_id JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = i.currency WHERE p.status = 'succeeded' AND p.paid_at >= '2025-01-01' AND p.paid_at < '2026-01-01'
